name: Cultist
description:
You are a member of the Cult of The Unknown and it is your mission to spread the faith to others.

When you gain this ability, if you have not already done so for the current campaign, determine the nature of The Unknown.

At the end of each Quest, you must pay 10% of the Treasure you acquired on the Quest - rounded up - to the Cult. In return, you receive a number of Tracts equal to the amount of Treasure you paid.

Once per rest, you may spend 10 minutes and expend one Tract to attempt to win a convert to your Cult: Roll Persuade vs Lore against a humanoid creature that can see, hear and understand you. On a win, increase the Difficulty by 1, the creature joins your Cult, gains this ability, and immediately pays 10% of its wealth to the Cult, receiving Tracts in return. On a loss, subsequent attempts to convert the creature automatically fail.

In a moment of need, you may call upon the power of your faith. At any time, when an effect would force you to make a skill check, you may instead use the Difficulty as the result for the roll. When you do, reset the Difficulty to 0.

Describe your methods of proselytizing.
